label: BASELINE. Deterministic simulation of the task's bad call. Not a real phone call.

results.title: identify_patient: dead silence while the tool runs
results.evidence: Tool ran 7.8s with no audio. soft_timeout_s is 8s, so the filler never fires for a 7.8s tool, and tool_call_sound is none.
results.where_it_lives: agent config (filler threshold, tool sound) plus backend tool (latency)
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)

results.title: Callers say "hello?" because of dead air
results.evidence: 1 'hello?' turn(s); longest gap from end of caller speech to agent audio was 9.0s.
results.where_it_lives: phone layer (turn detection, response latency) plus agent config
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)

results.title: Two half-answers stitched together (overlapping agent speech)

overlapping_pairs.a: Thank you, let me check that date
overlapping_pairs.b: Got it, one moment while I confirm

results.evidence: 2.0s where two agent replies play at once: a speculative reply was started on a partial transcript and not cancelled when the final transcript produced a second reply.
results.where_it_lives: phone layer (speculative turn handling, interruption and cancel logic)
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)

results.title: Whole call switches to Spanish on a single non-English word
results.evidence: language_rule flips to Spanish on "Sí, correct" and has no path back, so the caller's "English, please" is ignored.
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)

results.title: Says "You're all booked" after a timeout, then retries silently
results.evidence: book_appointment returned {"success": false, "error": "timeout"} and the agent still said "booked". The server had already written the row, and the background retry (no idempotency key) wrote it again.
results.where_it_lives: backend tool (idempotency, explicit status) plus prompt (only say booked on confirmed status)
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)

results.title: Duplicate parent appointments, none for the children
results.evidence: Records after the call: {'parent': 2, 'child1': 0, 'child2': 0, 'adult': 0}. The parent has a duplicate from failure 5, and the call ended before either child was booked.
results.where_it_lives: agent workflow state (one patient held, no booking list) plus backend tool
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)

results.title: Agent ends the call mid-booking
results.evidence: end_call fired from the silence timer while book_appointment for the second child was still pending, with no goodbye from the caller. Candidate cause A (proven in this replay): silence_end_call_s. Candidate cause B (not replayed): the wrap_up->end_call edge firing on the word 'No' in 'No, wait, my son too'. Real logs must show which one fired (end_call reason field).
results.where_it_lives: agent config (silence_end_call_s) and workflow edges (end_call guard)
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)

results.title: Fallback to the small model skips steps
results.evidence: After the large model timed out, the fallback ran ['choose_slot', 'book', 'confirm', 'wrap_up'] and skipped ['collect_patients', 'verify_dob']. Workflow state exists only in the model context, so the fallback cannot know where to resume. NOTE: which steps a real small model skips is MODELED here, per the task text; measure it in Phase 4.
results.where_it_lives: agent architecture (workflow state outside the model)
results.data_source: modeled behavior of the fallback model (needs real measurement in Phase 4)

results.title: 160K-character prompt with the knowledge base off
results.evidence: Every provider and location document is in the system prompt (160,000 chars, about 40,000 tokens by a 4-chars-per-token estimate) and is sent on every turn.
results.where_it_lives: prompt plus agent config (knowledge base off)
results.data_source: harness measurement of a synthetic prompt built to the 160,000-char size in the task; tokens are estimated

results.title: Cost per minute over budget (baseline recorded, no budget in the task)

metric.pricing_basis: Claude Sonnet 5.5 list price, no caching (see config/pricing.json)
metric.scope: LLM tokens only (no STT, TTS, telephony)

results.evidence: Token volume is a harness measurement (estimated at 4 chars per token). The dollar figure applies real list prices from config/pricing.json, but the baseline model is ASSUMED to be priced like Sonnet 5.5 (the task does not name it) and caching is ignored, so it is a modeled figure. The task gives no budget, so this records a baseline instead of pass or fail.
results.data_source: tokens: harness measurement (estimated); dollars: modeled with real list prices and an assumed model

results.title: Dashboard edits vanish on deploy
results.evidence: A dashboard edit was made, then a deploy from the repo replaced the live prompt with the older repo copy. The edit had no version, no review and no eval, and was never in the repo.
results.where_it_lives: deployment process (config and prompt are not code)
results.data_source: harness replay of the task log (simulation, not a real call)
